title: comments event line
description: One line of comments.jsonl = one event. Append-only. Records comment/resolution/promotion decisions by humans or the assistant on content drafts. content.json is the truth; this is the discussion log beside it.

event.description: Nine event types. comment.added creates a new comment_id; the rest reference one.

comment_id.description: Thread identifier uuid4 created by comment.added. Other events reference an existing comment_id.

author_principal.description: Who created the event. human:<session_id> or cc (assistant chat rail only).

body.description: Free text — untrusted. Escaped at render/prompt time. null allowed (resolution/promotion events etc.).

target_revision.description: draft_sha of the draft this event saw. sha256(production.draft)[:12].

result_revision.description: draft_sha of the draft after resolution. Required for resolution.accepted, otherwise null.

job_id.description: Related job id (future scope). Always null for now.

client_request_id.description: Client-generated uuid — idempotency key. Append is skipped when the same id arrives again.

causation_id.description: event_id of the preceding event that caused this one. resolution.* requires the event_id of the comment.added being resolved.
